semantic.justification: TaskQXFX41 ports original ScInputMode NONE0 TYPE1 TABLE2 TOP3 and bounded ScInputHandler mode predicates/toggle at native source boundaries. Browser scalar input shares one draft:TYPE arrows commit/move,TABLE and TOP keep caret navigation. Original SID_SETINPUTMODE26552 and F2 use the same shared-menu dispatcher;TYPE/TABLE toggles preserve draft/history,TOP commits before TABLE and rejected input retains mode/error. GetMode is a read-only browser projection of eMode,not an upstream method. EditEngine,protection,formula reference selection,autocomplete and VCL synchronization remain unported;no full native input parity is claimed.
